title: 京王杯ジュニアSの後に・いざ春へ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pleased with her performance, Sakura Bakushin O is raring to go take on the Classic Triple Crown tour. But I fear it's still too risky for her to take up the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Stalling for time to think things over, I ask her to run the Spring Stakes instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O decides to compete, assured that the Spring Stakes is but a stepping stone to eventually challenge the Satsuki Sho.
